scope: candidate guarded phrase rules; not run or validated on fixed97

rules.allow_when: standalone discourse phrase, preserve following punctuation
rules.block_when: inside quotation, code, title, or technical label
comparison, robustness, dependence, sensitivity, or quantitative relationship (e.g. 'robust with respect to', 'with respect to pp')

rules.allow_when: ordinary temporal clause and no fixed name/quoted string
rules.block_when: technical named entity or phrase where prior status is substantive
technical named entity or quoted string

global_guards: require token-boundary match and exact preservation of case/punctuation
never edit within math, citations, code, quoted text, named entities, units, numbers, acronyms, or chemical/genetic identifiers
never substitute content words from WordNet/embedding lists

block sentence if it includes statistical significance/p-value/CI, quantity/comparison, polarity/negation, causal/modal strength, or technical entity near target unless rule explicitly supports that relation
require immutable signature of all numerals, operators, units, negators, modal verbs, and named-entity-like strings
require source-anchored meaning review; overlap reduction alone is not acceptance
